arabic text: MUJH SE BAATEIN KARO, MERI ZAINAB KI MAA\nAEY MERI FATIMA
english translation text: SPEAK TO ME, O MOTHER OF MY ZAINAB (SA),\nO MY BIBI FATEMA (AS)

arabic text: JAANTI HO TUM HI MERI TANHAAIYAAN, AEY MERI FATIMA
english translation text: YOU ALONE KNOW MY LONELINESS, O MY BIBI FATEMA (AS)

arabic text: YA ZAHRA, YA ZAHRA, YA ZAHRA
english translation text: O ZAHRA (AS), O ZAHRA (AS), O ZAHRA (AS)

arabic text: ZAKHM KHAAYE BOHAT TUM NE MERE LIYE, TUM KO MAARA GAYA MERE HOTE HUWE\nMUJH KO TANHA KABHI TUM NE CHHODA NAHI, AANSU PONCHHE MERE TUM NE JIS HAATH SE\nTAAZIYAANE KA HAI AAJ US PAR NISHAAN, AEY MERI FATIMA
english translation text: YOU BORE SO MANY WOUNDS FOR MY SAKE, YOU WERE STRUCK WHILE I WAS STILL THERE\nYOU NEVER ONCE LEFT ME ALONE; THE HAND WITH WHICH YOU WIPED MY TEARS\nTODAY CARRIES THE MARK OF THE WHIP, O MY BIBI FATEMA (AS)

arabic text: MUJH SE BAATEIN KARO, MERI ZAINAB KI MAA\nAEY MERI FATIMA
english translation text: SPEAK TO ME, O MOTHER OF MY ZAINAB (SA),\nO MY BIBI FATEMA (AS)

arabic text: DEKHTE DEKHTE TUM ZAEEFAH HUWI, ZAKHM KHAAYE MAGAR KUCH NA BOLI KABHI\nAB MAIN SAMJHA KE TUM CHALTE CHALTE YEH KYUN MUJH SE KEHTI THI MAIN THAK GAYI YA ALI\nMAIN NE TOOTI HUWI DEKH LI PASLIYAAN, AEY MERI FATIMA
english translation text: BEFORE MY EYES YOU GREW FRAIL, YOU BORE WOUNDS BUT NEVER SAID A WORD\nNOW I UNDERSTAND WHY, AS YOU WALKED, YOU WOULD SAY TO ME: I AM TIRED, O ALI (AS)\nI HAVE SEEN YOUR BROKEN RIBS, O MY BIBI FATEMA (AS)

arabic text: MUJH SE BAATEIN KARO, MERI ZAINAB KI MAA\nAEY MERI FATIMA
english translation text: SPEAK TO ME, O MOTHER OF MY ZAINAB (SA),\nO MY BIBI FATEMA (AS)

arabic text: CHUP RAHA JAB TALAK TUM NE POOCHHA NAHI, HAAN SALAAM AB MUJHE KOI KARTA NAHI\nAEY MERI FATIMA, IS MADINE MEIN AB JITNA MAIN HOON KOI UTNA TANHA NAHI\nMERI HAMDARD THI EK TUM HI YAHAAN, AEY MERI FATIMA
english translation text: I STAYED SILENT FOR AS LONG AS YOU DID NOT ASK; YES, NOW NO ONE EVEN GREETS ME WITH SALAAM\nO MY BIBI FATEMA (AS), IN THIS MADINAH NOW NO ONE IS AS ALONE AS I AM\nYOU WERE THE ONLY ONE HERE WHO SHARED MY PAIN, O MY BIBI FATEMA (AS)

arabic text: MUJH SE BAATEIN KARO, MERI ZAINAB KI MAA\nAEY MERI FATIMA
english translation text: SPEAK TO ME, O MOTHER OF MY ZAINAB (SA),\nO MY BIBI FATEMA (AS)

arabic text: MAA KE GHAM KA USE KITNA EHSAAS THA, MUJH SE MERA HASSAN CHHUP KE ROTA RAHA\nKAISE WOH BOLTA, RAAH MEIN ZOR SE MAA KE RUKHSAAR PAR JAB TAMAACHA LAGA\nKHAAK PAR GIR GAYIN TOOT KAR BAALIYAAN, AEY MERI FATIMA
english translation text: HOW DEEPLY HE FELT HIS MOTHER'S GRIEF; MY HASSAN (AS) KEPT WEEPING, HIDDEN FROM ME\nHOW COULD HE SPEAK OF IT? ON THE PATH, WHEN A SLAP STRUCK HIS MOTHER'S CHEEK WITH FORCE\nHER EARRINGS BROKE AND FELL TO THE DUST, O MY BIBI FATEMA (AS)

arabic text: MUJH SE BAATEIN KARO, MERI ZAINAB KI MAA\nAEY MERI FATIMA
english translation text: SPEAK TO ME, O MOTHER OF MY ZAINAB (SA),\nO MY BIBI FATEMA (AS)

arabic text: TUM SE AABAAD THA MERA CHHOTA SA GHAR, APNE BACHCHON KO MAIN LE KE JAAUN KIDHAR\nTUM SE BEHTAR KOI KAISE SAMJHE BHALA, TUM NE KHOYA JISE BAIN DEEWAR O DAR\nMUJH KO WOH KEH SAKA BAAP NA TUM KO MAA, AEY MERI FATIMA
english translation text: MY LITTLE HOME WAS ALIVE BECAUSE OF YOU; WHERE NOW SHALL I TAKE MY CHILDREN?\nWHO COULD UNDERSTAND THIS BETTER THAN YOU? THE ONE YOU LOST BETWEEN THE WALL AND THE DOOR\nCOULD NEITHER CALL ME FATHER NOR CALL YOU MOTHER, O MY BIBI FATEMA (AS)

arabic text: MUJH SE BAATEIN KARO, MERI ZAINAB KI MAA\nAEY MERI FATIMA
english translation text: SPEAK TO ME, O MOTHER OF MY ZAINAB (SA),\nO MY BIBI FATEMA (AS)

arabic text: SUN KE ROTI RAHI ZAALIMON KI HANSI, TUM KO JHOOTI KAHA AUR SANAD PHAAD DI\nGHAR TALAK AAYI TUM AISE DARBAAR SE BAAP JAISE JAWAAN LAASH LAAYE KOI\nKHAT BANAATI RAHI KHAAK PAR AIDIYAAN, AEY MERI FATIMA
english translation text: HEARING THE OPPRESSORS' LAUGHTER, YOU KEPT WEEPING; THEY CALLED YOU A LIAR AND TORE UP YOUR DEED\nYOU MADE YOUR WAY HOME FROM THAT COURT AS A FATHER CARRIES HOME HIS YOUNG SON'S BODY\nYOUR HEELS KEPT DRAWING LINES IN THE DUST, O MY BIBI FATEMA (AS)

arabic text: MUJH SE BAATEIN KARO, MERI ZAINAB KI MAA\nAEY MERI FATIMA
english translation text: SPEAK TO ME, O MOTHER OF MY ZAINAB (SA),\nO MY BIBI FATEMA (AS)

arabic text: BAND KAR KE KAFAN DI ALI NE SADAA, MAR GAYA HAI ALI HO KE TUM SE JUDA\nTUM KO IS QABR MEIN JAB UTAAROONGA MAIN, HAATH PHAILAAYENGE KHUD RASOOL E KHUDA\nDAFAN TUM KO KAROON, MERE BAS MEIN KAHAAN, AEY MERI FATIMA
english translation text: TYING SHUT THE SHROUD, ALI (AS) CRIED OUT: ALI HAS DIED, PARTED FROM YOU\nWHEN I LOWER YOU INTO THIS GRAVE, THE MESSENGER OF GOD (SAWW) HIMSELF WILL OPEN HIS ARMS\nTO BURY YOU WITH MY OWN HANDS - HOW IS THAT IN MY POWER? O MY BIBI FATEMA (AS)

arabic text: MUJH SE BAATEIN KARO, MERI ZAINAB KI MAA\nAEY MERI FATIMA
english translation text: SPEAK TO ME, O MOTHER OF MY ZAINAB (SA),\nO MY BIBI FATEMA (AS)
